responsibility: Declares style and pedagogy-oriented checks aimed at novice-programmer mistakes in Modula-2 code. It provides routines to warn when an identifier differs from a keyword only by case and to scan variables, types, procedures, and records for confusingly similar names across scopes, separate from the core semantic legality checks.
same_name_distinction: This is the definition module for the M2Students pair: it only exports the two student-oriented naming-check entry points. Unlike `M2Students.mod`, it does not inspect symbol tables, track already-reported names, or emit the detailed meta-error warnings.
